chunks.text: Based on general Formula 1 knowledge rather than live race data, the Silver Arrows have a legendary history—from Juan Manuel Fangio's titles in 1954 and 1955 to winning eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021 in the turbo-hybrid era!

Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team has a legendary history, beginning with the iconic "Silver Arrows" and Juan Manuel Fangio's back-to-back titles in 1954 and 1955. Drawing on general F1 knowledge, their modern championship era is truly historic, featuring an unprecedented run of eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021.
